activity.notes: Andreotti headed three successive governments from 1976 through 1979. Because the premiership was continuous across cabinet reorganizations, ATLAS records one Activity for this uninterrupted spell rather than splitting III, IV and V into separate rows.

sources.title: Giulio Andreotti — Italian Ministry of Foreign Affairs
sources.citation_text: The Italian Foreign Ministry records Andreotti's first premiership in February 1972, formation of his second government in June 1972, his governments beginning in July 1976, March 1978 and March 1979, and his later foreign-ministerial career.

sources.title: La Presidenza del Consiglio dei Ministri — Governo Italiano
sources.citation_text: The Presidency of the Council's official appendix records the Andreotti VI government in 1989–1991 and Andreotti VII in 1991–1992.
